name: meta-app-scaffold
description: Create the apps/{name}/ directory tree — folder skeleton with spec/, plan/, and app/ axes plus seeded README, BRIEF, SPEC, ROADMAP stub files — for reference apps, playground apps, and clone-and-run demo apps. Greenfield mode chains meta-expert-author and plan-spec for substantive content. Reverse-engineering mode derives spec from existing app source via verified-surface protocol. NOT for authoring/scoring/critiquing a skill (use skills-studio); NOT for renaming/merging/splitting an existing skill across the library (use skills-refactor); NOT for auditing or repairing existing repo docs (use ops-repo).
